description: This file is a server-side route handler for the Estimates List page in a CRM project, built with SvelteKit. It handles data fetching, transformation, and CRUD actions related to invoice estimates, integrating with backend API endpoints, and managing filters, pagination, and user actions.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads estimates data, applies filters, handles pagination, and fetches auxiliary data like accounts, contacts, and templates. Transforms backend API responses into frontend structures, ready for rendering.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new estimate by parsing form data and sending a POST request to the backend API.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles updating an existing estimate identified by estimateId, sending a PUT request with modified data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an estimate specified by estimateId via a DELETE request.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Triggers sending an estimate via backend API, e.g., email notification.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts an estimate into an invoice by calling the corresponding backend API endpoint.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Marks an estimate as accepted by updating its status.

methods.name: decline
methods.description: Marks an estimate as declined by updating its status.
